EVAL-CT-MEASURE-1-S1.title: Trial Phase Scoring Schema and Contract
EVAL-CT-MEASURE-1-S1.description: Define deterministic mapping of phases (I, II, III, IV, and combined phases like I/II) to normalized scores (0–1), including explicit handling for unknown/null values and output contract fields: phase_raw, phase_normalized, score, confidence.

EVAL-CT-MEASURE-1-S2.title: Core Trial Phase Scoring Logic
EVAL-CT-MEASURE-1-S2.description: Implement pure function scoring logic that maps normalized phase values to scores with strict ordering (IV highest), includes parsing of combined phases (e.g., II/III), and defaults for invalid inputs with confidence downgrade.

EVAL-CT-MEASURE-1-S3.title: Integration with Clinical Trials Service Pipeline
EVAL-CT-MEASURE-1-S3.description: Augment clinical_trials_service pipeline to attach phase scoring output to each trial object, ensuring non-breaking extension of existing response schema and preservation of original phase text.

EVAL-CT-MEASURE-1-S4.title: Expose Trial Phase Quality via Facade/API
EVAL-CT-MEASURE-1-S4.description: Expose phase quality fields (phase_normalized, score, confidence) through evaluate_care_facade tool responses consumed by chat, ensuring consistent serialization and no schema drift.

EVAL-CT-MEASURE-1-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Phase Scoring
EVAL-CT-MEASURE-1-S5.description: Add unit tests for mapping (I–IV, combined phases, invalid/null) and integration tests validating presence and correctness of scoring fields in end-to-end clinical trial responses via facade.
